name: Nostalgia in every visit
source:
“This place has never changed after 20 years.”

A short kinetic novel about a man who visits this place every year, focusing on feelings of love and strong nostalgia.

[From [url=https://ronymaki.itch.io/nostalgia-in-every-visit]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“20年来，这个地方从未改变过。”

这是一部简短的动态小说，讲述了一个每年都会访问这个地方的男人的故事，重点关注爱的感受和强烈的怀旧之情。

[来自[url=https://ronymaki.itch.io/nostalgia-in-every-visit]itch.io[/url]]
